div.div:
Why the save happens inside
the callback
ScaledStrip streams each slice out and releases source images as it goes. Collecting slices into a list first would hold the whole chapter in RAM; writing them here keeps one slice and about two sources alive at a time, whatever the length.

div.div:
pageTopByInputUid is built here
because this loop is the only point in a run where a page's uid and its strip-Y are both known.
A page that failed to load gets no entry, so an overlay anchored to it is reported orphaned instead of landing on a neighbour.

div.div:
How a fatal slice error leaves the region
writeSlice() returns false, sliceAll() stops streaming and returns
normally, and render() then sees outcome.failed and returns it.
The activity ends either way — but nothing is thrown across the
region boundary, and slices already written stay on disk.
